title: The Home Depot is giving away free Ryobi tools for Black Friday
text:

 I combed through The Home Depot’s holiday offers and found the best BOGO tool deals, price cuts on major appliances and more.
 Kasey Caminiti USA TODAY Updated Oct. 29, 2026, 4:51 p.m. ET Hear this story The Home Depot is rolling out early Black Friday deals, including free Ryobi tools.
 I've covered enough Black Fridays to know that saving $15 on something you weren't planning to buy isn't much of a deal. I want brag-worthy discounts and free stuff.
 And that's exactly why The Home Depot's Black Friday 2026 deals are worth paying attention to, especially if power tools , lawn equipment or a major home appliance are already on your shopping list.
 The Home Depot's holiday Tool Gift Center is live now through Jan. 31, 2027, with BOGO and free-tool promotions across Ryobi, Milwaukee, DeWalt, Makita and Ridgid.
 There are also two big dates I'd circle if you're shopping for your home: The Home Depot's Black Friday appliance deals run from Nov. 4 through Dec. 2 , while select outdoor power equipment will be up to $250 off from Nov. 5 through Dec. 6 . Here's everything you need to know about how to save at The Home Depot for Black Friday 2026.
 Don't miss out! Get weekly deals, trends and product recommendations from USA TODAY Shopping delivered straight to your inbox. Shop The Home Depot Black Friday deals The Home Depot Black Friday deal dates to know
 Tool Gift Center : Oct. 26, 2026 to Jan. 31, 2027
 Black Friday appliances : Nov. 4 to Dec. 2, 2026
 Outdoor power equipment : Up to $250 off select equipment Nov. 5 to Dec. 6
 The Home Depot is giving away free Ryobi tools for Black Friday
 Free tools are the Black Friday offer I’d check first at The Home Depot. Personally, I love Ryobi tools and how easy the system is. All my tools use the same batteries and it makes life so much easier.
 The Home Depot has the Ryobi One+ 1/2-inch Drill/Circular Saw Combo Kit for new homeowners and renters on sale for 42% off (less than $80), plus bonus-tool options.
 Free Ryobi tools with select purchases can include:
 Ryobi One+ 18V Cordless Compact Workshop Blower (Tool Only)
 Ryobi One+ 18V 13-Inch Cordless Battery String Trimmer (Tool Only)
 Ryobi One+ 18V Cordless Oscillating Multi- Tool (Tool Only)
 Ryobi One+ 18V Cordless Reciprocating Saw (Tool Only)
 Ryobi One+ 18V Cordless Hybrid WHISPER SERIES 7-1/2 in. Fan (Tool Only)
 Get free Ryobi tools at The Home Depot Milwaukee and DeWalt Black Friday deals are worth a look, too
 Already own Milwaukee or DeWalt batteries?
 The Home Depot's featured holiday products include a Milwaukee M18 5Ah two-pack starter kit for 65% off and up to $130 off DeWalt power tools . For more established DIYers, don't miss a Milwaukee M18 Fuel two-piece combo kit and DeWalt 20V brushless eight-tool combo kit .
 The Home Depot Black Friday appliance event runs through Dec. 2
 If your refrigerator, range or laundry set is due for an upgrade, The Home Depot's Black Friday appliance deals run from Nov. 4 through Dec. 2 .
 LG Smart Counter Depth Max French Door Refrigerator with Internal Water Dispenser in PrintProof Stainless Steel
 This LG counter-depth three-door French-door refrigerator features an ice and water dispenser and Craft Ice.
 Save $1,050 on this LG refrigerator deal GE Profile Smart 4-Door French Door Refrigerator with Door-in-Door in Fingerprint resistant, stainless Steel
 The featured GE Profile four-door French-door refrigerator has a 27.9-cu.-ft. capacity, Kitchen Assistant and scan-to-shopping-list technology.
 Save $1,200 on the GE Profile refrigerator deal LG Electric Single Smart Oven Range with Air Fry, Convection, EasyClean and Premium Handle in Stainless Steel
 The priority assortment also includes an LG 30-inch electric range with convection, Air Fry and EasyClean.
 Save $150 on the LG range deal Cafe 24-Inch Built-In Top Control 44 dBA Dishwasher in Matte White with Stainless Tub, Ultra Wash & Dual Convection Dry
 If your dishwasher is the appliance due for an upgrade, add the Café 24-Inch Built-In Top Control Dishwasher to your Black Friday watch list. The matte-white finish makes it a particularly good-looking option, while a stainless-steel tub, 44-dBA operation, Ultra Wash and Dual Convection Dry give it the practical features I'd want from an everyday kitchen upgrade.
 Save $400 on the Cafe dishwasher deal More: Lowe’s 4 weeks of Black Friday deals start now with extra member perks Save up to $250 on outdoor power equipment at The Home Depot
 This is one of the easiest Black Friday offers to shop: The Home Depot has up to $250 off select outdoor power equipment from Nov. 5 through Dec. 6 .
 If a mower or other outdoor power equipment is already on your replacement list, I'd check this event before waiting until spring.
 Deal: Up to $250 off select outdoor power equipment
 Dates: Nov. 5 to Dec. 6
